anchors: station0b head-section table (cage-spec.json anchors, read at fit time; not duplicated here)
collisionField: hair-cage1/body-exact-sdf.npz (Blender BVHTree closest point + ray-parity sign, 2 mm grid; negative inside)
comment: frozen before any fit; sha recorded in spec-sha-before-fit.txt and RESULT.txt; no edits after the sha
coverageRadius: tube_r swept per guide, rasterized with body occlusion (depth-tested against hair-cage1/body-depth.npz)
acromion: per side, the body-mesh vertex maximizing |X| among verts with drop D in [225, 290] mm (world z 1.370-1.435 m, the shoulder band): R (+171.3, U -16.9), L (-171.3, U -16.9) mm. Side-sector guides (|az| in [45,135] deg) must pass posterior to the acromion U at the shoulder waypoint (U_wp < -16.9). Measured from hair-station0b/body-verts.npz in the head frame of this spec.
earFrontNote: most-anterior body-mesh vertex with 70 < |X| < 110 mm and world z in [1.50, 1.58] m reads U = +11.7 mm; plane rounded to +12. The relu field bounds let the side sector release at or behind this plane (default side release shell U ~ -49 mm plus relu_c0 -20 mm = ~ -69 mm).
fall: fall from the release point (U shifted by the relu field) through a shoulder waypoint at drop 255 mm (the shoulder plane: crown 1.6599 m - 0.255 m = 1.4049 m ~= 1.405 m) with lateral magnitude wpx(az) and posterior position wpu(az); below the waypoint straight fall with lateral spread + posterior drift; a mid-fall sway bow over the whole fall; every sample projected to >= 3 mm exact-SDF clearance during generation
frame: head mm: X lateral, U anterior+ rel crown, D drop below crown; world(m) = (X/1000, crown_y - U/1000, crown_z - D/1000)
growth: (a) shell ride from the shell point above the root along the departure direction on the offset section-ellipse shell, to the release contour; side = sign of root X; departure pushes |azimuth| toward 90 deg (|dep| = |a| + part in the front half, |a| - part in the back half, continuous at |a| = 90), so |x| grows and no guide leaves its half-plane above its release (crossing count gated 0); (b) release with U offset relu(az); (c) waypoint-routed fall; deterministic given (roots, params)
paramsNote: 28 field parameters (card allows 20-32), all smooth azimuth/elevation fields; mirrored guides share every parameter (side = sign of root X)
regularizers: curvature (fall second differences), neighbour-smoothness (adjacent-azimuth release/end/waypoint drops), soft mirror symmetry (end drops)
release: release contour drop D_rel(az) = rel_c0 + rel_c1*cos(az) + rel_s1*sin(az); clamped >= root drop + 10 mm; release U = shell U at (D_rel, departure azimuth) + relu(az) with relu(az) = relu_c0 + relu_c1*cos(az) + relu_s1*sin(az)
roots: E/roots-v2.npz (423 guide roots Poisson-subsampled at 11.0 mm from scalp1 real roots hair-scalp1/roots.npz, 14,155 roots; positions + normals in the head frame of this spec)
shell: offset shell of the scalp: station0b head-section ellipses (anchors table from cage-spec.json: rows [drop, xmax, ufront, uback]); section point ((a+d)*sin(th), cu+(b+d)*cos(th)) with a=xmax, b=(uf-ub)/2, cu=(uf+ub)/2, d = shell_h + lift; shell_h(h,az) = sh_base + sh_elev*(h/100) + sh_cos*cos(az) + sh_sin*sin(az) + sh_c2*cos(2*az), clamped >= 0.5 mm (the sh_c2 lateral term lets the crown narrow sideways: cos(2*az) = -1 at the sides). Shell-ride blends section angle root-azimuth -> departure azimuth (root azimuth pushed laterally by part_angle). Section columns are median-3 filtered at shell-read time (station-owned smoothing; raw table untouched).
specV1toV2diff: roots provisional-276 -> scalp1-subsampled-423 (file swap only); side assignment pinned to root-X sign with crossing gate 0; + relu_c0/c1/s1 release-U field (side sector can release at/behind the ear-front plane U=+12); sho_c0/c1/s1 shoulder-U target REPLACED by waypoint fields wpu_c0/c1/s1 (U at drop 255) + wpx_c0/c1 (lateral magnitude at drop 255, side-preserving) routing side-sector falls behind the acromion (U -16.9); + sh_c2 lateral shell term (crown can narrow); + hem_u smooth back-U end term hem_u*(1-cos(az))/2 (back hem lengthens without cos2 steps); spread/drift/sway/end-Fourier/tube_r semantics unchanged; 21 -> 28 params
waypointNote: at drop 255 the torso half-width is ~83 mm (section table) and the acromion tips sit at |X| = 171 mm, U = -17 mm; the waypoint default (|X| = 110, U = -60) threads between them, posterior to the acromion, so the fall routes around the shoulder instead of through it
